covpp.evaluation.district_evaluation module

District-level evaluation for aggregating zone statistics.

class DistrictStatsBase

Bases: object

Container for aggregated district-level KPIs.

Result:

Holds the sums/ratios derived from all zone statistics so they can be serialized once per planning run via get_data_dict().

get_data_dict() → dict

Convert statistics to dictionary format for serialization.

class DistrictEvaluationHandler(result_file: str = None)

Bases: object

Aggregate zone metrics into a single district report.

Process:

  1. Accept a list of ZoneStatsBase objects after every zone finishes.

  2. Sum compatible quantities, recompute ratios, and store them in self.stats.

  3. Persist the aggregated report to result_file for later inspection.

evaluate(zone_stats: list[ZoneStatsBase])

Aggregate zone statistics to compute district-level metrics.

save_result()

save district statistics to json file.

covpp.evaluation.zone_evaluation_base module

Zone evaluation base classes.

class ZoneStatsBase

Bases: object

Lightweight DTO that captures zone-level KPIs.

Result:

Instances accumulate coverage/sequence/evaluation metrics that can be serialized via get_data_dict() and consumed by district aggregators.

Attributes mirror the JSON payload (map identifiers, timing, path metrics, coverage ratios, and areas in px/m). All values default to None or 0 so evaluators can fill them progressively.

get_data_dict() → dict

Get statistics data as a dictionary.

class ZoneEvaluationBase(zmd: ZoneMapData, paths: SequencePaths)

Bases: object

Base interface for computing zone statistics from generated paths.

Process:

  1. Hold references to ZoneMapData plus the SequencePaths bundle.

  2. Implement evaluate() to fill self.stats with KPI values.

  3. Optionally persist results via save_result().

Result:

self.stats must be a populated ZoneStatsBase instance after evaluate completes successfully.

evaluate(times: float = 0.0)

evaluate zone statistics. To be implemented in derived classes.

save_result()

save zone statistics and planner statistics of the zone to json file.

validate_data(times: dict) → bool

check if data are valid for evaluation.
